Splits a bot's tools between the app and the VM, for group chats that run on the VM. Nothing changes for your groups until you turn that on.

## Install

**One command** in PowerShell. It installs Hermes Agent too if it's missing, checks the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and opens the app:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or by hand:** download **`NexurBots-Setup-1.8.12.exe`** below and run it. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** If you download the installer in a browser, Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. The one-command install doesn't get that prompt.
- No auto-update: install a newer `NexurBots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Changes

- **Tool split (for operators).** When a VM runner is set in the app's settings (`runnerGroupsUrl`), a bot's four group-conversation tools (`post_to_group`, `list_groups`, `rename_group`, `reply_in_thread`) come from the runner. The other eight tools (`ask_user`, `send_file`, and the rest) stay on this PC under their own server name, `hermes-bots-app`. Without the setting, every tool stays on this PC, as before.
- **Older versions.** Install 1.8.12 on every computer that opens a runner group. Versions 1.8.11 and earlier don't know how to split the tools.
